text:
anita: Quick flag  firewall change scheduled 23:00 UTC will flip infra egress to deny-by-default for 10.200.0.0/16. Concern: GPU warm-pool in usw2 uses NAT -> regional KMS. If KMS egress is blocked nodes will fail disk decrypts on boot. Can we gate tonight's rollout?

ryan: which PR is this?

security-oncall: PR #7002. It tightens egress to operator CIDRs only. No KMS vpce or NAT EIP entries included.

kevin: We've seen this in staging: cloud-init loops on decrypt with errors like `AccessDeniedException` for the KMS key when the nat egress is blocked. Node never joins cluster.

sre-ops-bot: ALERT: 2025-10-12T22:45:00Z  observed 5 gpu nodes with decrypt errors during dry-run. Log sample: "cloud-init: volume_decrypt: ERROR: AccessDeniedException: User not authorized to use KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01"

emma: Avoid fragile IP lists for AWS endpoints. Quick mitigations: (A) add KMS VPC endpoint IDs (vpce-0a1b2c) to allowlist, (B) exempt warm-pool subnets from default-deny, (C) whitelist NAT GW EIP(s) as fallback. Long-term: enable proxy FQDN allow for `kms.*.amazonaws.com`.

ryan: Our firewall is CIDR-only today, correct? FQDN rules require proxy.

security-oncall: Correct. Proxy FQDN solution is not ready for tonight. Fast path: hotfix to PR #7002 adding vpce allowlist + NAT EIP fallback, and a smoke test.

anita: I'll hold the rollout and open hotfix PR adding vpce-0a1b2c and NAT EIP 54.210.11.22. Also adding runbook smoke test steps.

kevin: Smoke test to add: from warm-pool subnet `curl -v https://kms.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/` and `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://test.blob`. Verify EBS attach+decrypt succeeds and node registers within 5m.

emma: I'll draft runbook PR + alert: `gpu.node.decrypt.failures > 0 for 5m` -> page oncall and auto-pause infra rollouts via webhook.

security-oncall: Holding rollout. Do not merge PR #7002 until vpce allowlist or NAT EIP whitelist or confirmed proxy FQDN rule in place. I'll comment on the PR and set release blocked.

ryan: Ack. Release window held; rollback window 23:15 UTC.

anita: Hotfix PR #7005 opened. Will update when smoke tests pass.

sre-ops-bot: Follow-ups created: runbook PR #7008, hotfix PR #7005, alert PR #7009.
